changeSet.author: nexus-bivz3.5
changeSet.comment: RDR-231 backfill (nexus-bivz3.5): rewrites note source_uris from chroma://<collection>/<title> to nx-note://<collection>/<title>, and nxexp://<target>/chroma://<collection>/... to nxexp://<target>/nx-note://<collection>/..., when the collection is not file-routed (rdr__, docs__, code__ stay). Scheme only: the collection segment is never repaired. A guard aborts the transaction, changing nothing, when a live note has a live twin in the nx-note:// spelling. DATA EFFECT: UPDATEs nexus.catalog_documents.source_uri, nexus.document_aspects.source_uri and nexus.document_highlights.source_uri for every live and tombstoned note row, in one transaction; irreversible (the old spelling is not recorded and the rollback is empty).
